name: brandwright
topic: Brand-consistent UI mock-ups with image models: routes (code from design tokens, reference conditioning, brand and sub-site LoRAs), how brand and sub-site LoRAs combine, licences of open image models for company use
volatile_claims: Default base model is Z-Image (Apache-2.0); Qwen-Image-2512 for 24 GB; FLUX.2 klein 4B for the reference route (2026-10-15)
Qwen-Image-2.1, FLUX.2 dev/klein 9B and Ideogram 4 are not licensed for commercial use; FLUX 3 klein and Krea 2 have revenue limits (2026-10-15)
FLUX.2 klein takes up to 4 reference images (BFL spec table, 2026-06)
